headline: Brazilian Pharmacy Chain RD Saúde Approves $100 Million Share Buyback
summary: The board of directors of Brazilian pharmacy retailer RD Saúde approved a share buyback program of up to 127.59 million shares valued at up to R$ 600 million ($100 million).
why: RD Saúde (Raia Drogasil) is Brazil's largest drugstore chain by revenue and location count.

impacts.name: RD Saúde
impacts.why: RD Saúde authorized a R$ 600 million share repurchasing program.
